name: ConvertKit
tagline: ConvertKit is an email marketing platform built for creators including writers, podcasters, and course sellers. It handles subscriber management, automated email sequences, and a commerce layer for selling digital products directly to your list. AI writing tools help draft newsletters and subject lines, and the free plan covers up to 10,000 subscribers.
